def sha256(path: Path) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def load_json(path: Path):
    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def get_font_source(tmp: Path) -> Path:
    env = os.environ.get("JZ_NOTO_SANS_SC")
    target = tmp / "NotoSansSC-VF.ttf"
    if env:
        shutil.copyfile(Path(env), target)
    else:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(FONT_URL, timeout=120) as response, target.open("wb") as out:
            shutil.copyfileobj(response, out)
    actual = sha256(target)
    if actual != FONT_SHA256:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Noto Sans SC hash mismatch: {actual}")
    return target


def static_font(vf_path: Path, weight: int, output: Path):
    variable = FTFont(str(vf_path))
    static = instantiateVariableFont(variable, {"wght": weight}, inplace=False, optimize=True)
    static.save(str(output))


def subset_woff2(ttf_path: Path, chars: str, output: Path):
    font = FTFont(str(ttf_path))
    options = subset.Options()
    options.flavor = "woff2"
    options.layout_features = ["*"]
    options.name_IDs = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 13, 14]
    options.name_legacy = True
    options.name_languages = [0x409, 0x804]
    sub = subset.Subsetter(options=options)
    sub.populate(text="".join(sorted(set(chars))))
    sub.subset(font)
    font.flavor = "woff2"
    font.save(str(output))

def coords(geom):
    typ = geom.get("type")
    value = geom.get("coordinates", [])
    if typ == "Polygon":
        return value[0]
    if typ == "LineString":
        return value
    return []


def map_project(point, extent, box):
    minx, miny, maxx, maxy = extent
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = box
    pad = 0.03
    rx = (point[0] - minx) / (maxx - minx)
    ry = (point[1] - miny) / (maxy - miny)
    return (
        x0 + (pad + rx * (1 - 2 * pad)) * (x1 - x0),
        y1 - (pad + ry * (1 - 2 * pad)) * (y1 - y0),
    )


def dash_line(draw: ImageDraw.ImageDraw, pts, fill, width=5, dash=18, gap=12):
    for a, b in zip(pts, pts[1:]):
        dx, dy = b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]
        length = math.hypot(dx, dy)
        if length == 0:
            continue
        ux, uy = dx / length, dy / length
        cursor = 0.0
        while cursor < length:
            end = min(cursor + dash, length)
            draw.line((a[0] + ux * cursor, a[1] + uy * cursor, a[0] + ux * end, a[1] + uy * end), fill=fill, width=width)
            cursor += dash + gap


def arrow(draw, a, b, fill=TEAL, width=7):
    draw.line((*a, *b), fill=fill, width=width)
    ang = math.atan2(b[1] - a[1], b[0] - a[0])
    for off in (2.55, -2.55):
        q = (b[0] + 22 * math.cos(ang + off), b[1] + 22 * math.sin(ang + off))
        draw.line((*b, *q), fill=fill, width=width)

def draw_base_map(b: Board, geo, extent, box, layers=(), labels=True):
    b.rounded(box, PALE, LINE, 28, 2)
    fill_by_code = {"0802": "#B8CAD1", "1401": "#B8C9AE", "05": "#E5C994", "0702": "#C8BDD8"}
    for layer in layers:
        collection = geo.get(layer, {"features": []})
        for f in collection.get("features", []):
            points = [map_project(p, extent, box) for p in coords(f["geometry"])]
            props = f["properties"]
            if not points:
                continue
            if layer == "land_use":
                b.d.polygon(points, fill=fill_by_code.get(props.get("land_use_code"), SAND), outline=WHITE)
            elif layer == "green_space":
                b.d.polygon(points, fill="#769B75", outline=GREEN)
            elif layer == "public_space":
                b.d.polygon(points, fill="#D5AF67", outline=GOLD)
            elif layer == "buildings":
                b.d.polygon(points, fill="#7C6962", outline=INK)
            elif layer == "phasing":
                b.d.polygon(points, fill="#D84B2C33", outline=ORANGE)
            elif layer == "roads":
                b.d.line(points, fill=BLUE, width=12)
            elif layer == "key_areas":
                b.d.polygon(points, fill="#FFFFFF88", outline=TEAL)
                if labels:
                    cx = sum(p[0] for p in points[:-1]) / max(1, len(points) - 1)
                    cy = sum(p[1] for p in points[:-1]) / max(1, len(points) - 1)
                    label = props["id"].split("-")[-1]
                    b.d.ellipse((cx - 25, cy - 25, cx + 25, cy + 25), fill=DARK)
                    b.text((cx, cy), label, 19, WHITE, True, "mm")
    boundary = [map_project(p, extent, box) for p in coords(geo["site_boundary"]["features"][0]["geometry"])]

def pdf_header(c, page_size, title, subtitle, reg_name, bold_name, page):
    pw, ph = page_size
    c.setFillColor(HexColor(BG)); c.rect(0, 0, pw, ph, fill=1, stroke=0)
    c.setFillColor(HexColor(ORANGE)); c.rect(0, ph - 11, pw, 11, fill=1, stroke=0)
    c.setFillColor(HexColor(INK)); c.setFont(bold_name, 18); c.drawString(34, ph - 40, title)
    c.setFillColor(HexColor(MUTED)); c.setFont(reg_name, 8); c.drawRightString(pw - 34, ph - 38, subtitle)
    c.setFillColor(HexColor(MUTED)); c.setFont(reg_name, 7); c.drawString(34, 20, "CONCEPT · PROVISIONAL ROUGH EXTENT · NOT AN OFFICIAL REDLINE")
    c.setFillColor(HexColor(ORANGE)); c.setFont(bold_name, 8); c.drawRightString(pw - 34, 20, page)


def fit_image(c, path: Path, box):
    x, y, w, h = box
    iw, ih = Image.open(path).size
    scale = min(w / iw, h / ih)
    dw, dh = iw * scale, ih * scale
    c.drawImage(str(path), x + (w - dw) / 2, y + (h - dh) / 2, dw, dh, preserveAspectRatio=True, mask="auto")

def write_rebuild_source():
    source = SCRIPT_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    source_bytes = source.encode("utf-8")
    payload = {
        "format": "open-city-reviewable-generator-source-v1",
        "language": "python",
        "source_sha256": hashlib.sha256(source_bytes).hexdigest(),
        "restore_as": "rebuild_jingzhang_visuals_v2.py",
        "instructions": "Decode the JSON source string as UTF-8 with LF newlines, save it as restore_as, install Pillow/fonttools/brotli/reportlab, then run it from any location. The script resolves this submission when restored under visual/assets or from the workspace parent used by the author.",
        "source": source,
    }
    (VIS_ASSETS / "rebuild-visuals-source.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
        newline="\n",
    )
